Commentary.Commentary: The target is 151 and looking at the Australian batting line up, it looks like they will be able to chase it down. However, one can never say what the Pakistani bowlers can come up with. Join us after the break for the chase.

Ashton Agar is down for an interview. He says it looks a good wicket to bat on and he backs his batters to chase this down. On the run out of Azam, he says Warner was exceptional and he gives everything out there in the middle. States that Babar Azam's run out was crucial in the context of where Pakistan would finish.

The Australian bowlers did well right until the death overs. It has been a problematic area for them and it proved again. Ashton Agar and Pat Cummins bowled well as they restricted the scoring in the middle overs and also kept chipping wickets in between. Kane Richardson, however, had a very bad day at the office and was smashed to all parts of the ground. He conceded 51 runs off his 4 overs and that has pushed Australia on the back foot somewhat.

The innings started positively for Pakistan as Babar Azam played some good strokes and got into his stride. However, Pat Cummins came into the attack and struck straightaway to dismiss Fakhar Zaman. After that, it was always about Pakistan gaining momentum and Australia stopping them. Haris Sohail, Mohammad Rizwan and Asif Ali all struggled with Babar Azam trying to keep his side in the game. Azam scored 50 runs off 38 balls and laid the foundation for the finishers to come in and do their job. Iftikhar Ahmed came in and did just that in the final overs. Ahmed scored 62 off 34 and pushed the Pakistani score to a respectable total. However, Australia have themselves to blame for that as Steven Smith and Ben McDermott both dropped him. Though the one the latter put down was a tough one to take.

Pakistan have reached a total of 150 and it is all due to one man, Iftikhar Ahmed. He has played a gem of an innings and it is because of him that Pakistan have been able to put a competitive total on the board.

On the pads, Iftikhar flicks it through mid-wicket and gets a couple to end the innings. Good last over from Starc but cannot restrict Pakistan under 150. PAKISTAN FINISH OFF WITH 150 OFF THEIR 20 OVERS.
Fuller on middle, Iftikhar hits it wide of long on and this time gets the couple he wants.
Wahab Riaz is the new man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Imad looked to be short and he is short. Low full toss on middle and off, Iftikhar hits it wide of long off and looks for two. Smith gets to the ball quickly and releases a brilliant throw. Starc takes the bails off and Imad's dive sees him fall short.
Fuller on off, Imad drives it towards sweeper cover for a single. Australia and Starc won't mind singles off the last over.
Fuller on middle and leg, Ifthikhar flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Good length ball on off, Imad hits it straight. Too straight as the ball goes onto hit the stumps at the other end. Just a single.

IN THE AIR BUT OVER THE ROPES. Fuller on middle and leg, Iftikhar heaves it over long on. Ben McDermott there almost pulls a stunning catch. He gets his hands to it but fails to keep it in. Will go down as a drop but that is harsh to call it as a drop. 22 off Richardson's last. Spoils his figures. He ends with the figures of 4-0-51-1.

FOUR! This is brilliant batting. Full outside off, Iftikhar creams it over point for a boundary. Richardson under the pump. Fifty for Iftikhar Ahmed. His first in T20Is and what a knock this has been! Pulled his side out of the ashes here.
TOP EDGE AND FOUR! Back of a length ball on off, Iftikhar looks to go for the pull but he gets a top edge on it. The ball goes over jumping Carey for a boundary! Harsh game for the bowlers.
Full on off, Imad strokes it to long off and gives Iftikhar the strike.
In the air but safe! Full on off, Iftikhar looks to go over covers but does not time it well. Luckily for him it falls short of the man in the deep. Single taken.
SIX!Bang! Perfect start to the over for Pakistan. Good length ball on off, Iftikhar waits for it and demolishes it over the long off fence for a biggie.
Richardson to bowl the penultimate over of the innings.
Good over from Starc at this stage of the game. Just 6 off it he will take it. Good length ball on top of middle and leg, Imad looks to ramp by moving away from the stumps. He misses it though.
FOUR! This time Imad manages to connect and find the gap. Full and wide outside off, Imad clears his front leg and smashes it through mid off and cover for a boundary.
This is smart bowling from Starc. Bowls a slower one by rolling his fingers on this one. Imad looks to go hard at it but once again just hits it back to Mitchell.
Full toss but Imad cannot make the most of it. It is on  middle and off, Imad clears his front leg but just manages to hit back at Starc.
Fuller on middle, Imad strokes it wide of long on and gets a couple.
Good length ball outside off, Imad swings his bat but misses.
Mitchell Starc is back. Looks like he will bowl the 18th and the final over. 2-0-11-0, his figures so far.
Length ball on off, cut by Wasim towards point for one.

DROPPED! Life given to Iftikhar Ahmed! On the pads of Ahmed, he flicks this one towards mid-wicket. The ball goes uppishly with Steven Smith running towards it. He puts in a slide to his right, gets two hands to it but drops it in the end. A routine catch for a fielder of his caliber but Steven has dropped it and the batters take one. Will this come back to bite them?
Length ball on off, Ahmed defends this one off the back foot.
FOUR! Ahmed finds the gap! Length ball outside off, Ahmed rocks back and cuts this one through backward point for a boundary.
Length ball on off, Wasim cuts this one towards point and takes a run.
On the pads of Iftikhar Ahmed, he flicks this one in front of square for a single.
Imad Wasim is the new man in. Pat Cummins has also returned to bowl his final over of the match.

RUN OUT! It looked out to the naked eye and it is indeed out! Babar Azam gets to his fifty and goes out in the same ball. Excellent from David Warner. He has got this wicket out of nowhere. Floated on middle and leg, Babar Azam flicks it wide of deep mid-wicket and looks for two. Warner gets to the ball in a flash and has a shy at the keeper's end. He hits bull's eye. Babar puts in a dive but looks to be short. The square leg umpire goes upstairs to check and replay shows Babar is short of his crease and the dive is not enough to save him. Australia needed this wicket as this duo was starting to take the charge. Anticlimactic end to Babar's beautiful innings. He gets to his 12th T20I fifty and this might be the one he will not remember too fondly for the way it has ended.
The umpire has gone upstairs for a run out. It looks out to the naked eye after some brilliant work from David Warner.
Now squeezes it to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Iftikhar took his time but now he is going after them. Floated on off, Iftikhar goes aerial and lofts it over covers for a boundary.
Floated on middle and leg, Babar comes down the track and milks it to long on for another single.
Iftikhar comes down the track and hits it hard but there is a man in deep at mid-wicket so just a single.
Flatter on middle and off, Babar comes down the track but gets an inside edge. The ball deflects to the off side off his pad. They take a single.
Agar to bowl out. He has been brilliant. 2/14 off his 3 overs.

Another couple and Pakistan gaining some momentum finally. Fuller delivery on the pads, Ahmed slams this one down the ground. McDermott from long on parries it towards Finch who comes from long off and the batters are able to take two.
This time a couple. Good batting by Iftikhar. He creams this one towards the cover region where David Warner from sweeper cover puts in a dive and saves a couple of runs for his team.
SIX! Iftikhar taking the attack to the Aussies now. Short of a length on the body, Ahmed pulls this one over mid-wicket for a biggie. First of the game.
FOUR! Length ball on off again, this time Ahmed predicts it early and lofts this one over extra cover for a boundary.
Another length ball on off, Ahmed pushes this one towards the man at cover.
Length ball on off, Ahmed looks to cut this one but misses. Whizzes past the outside edge.
Richardson is back on. 2-0-15-1, his numbers.
On the pads of Ahmed, he flicks it towards square leg and takes a single.
Azam has played the square drive. The batters have run through for a single.
Zampa drags this one back again. Ahmed rocks back and plays this one towards point for one.
Ahmed opens the face of the bat and guides this one towards third man.
Zampa drags this one and it is pulled away by Azam for a single towards square leg.
Floated on middle, Ahmed looks to defend but gets an inside edge on it towards the leg side. The batters scamper for a quick single.
Zampa to bowl out from the other end now. 3-0-27-0, his figures so far.
Bouncer by Cummins down the leg side. Ahmed pulls this one towards backward square leg and takes a single to end the over.
Good length ball on off, Ahmed looks to flick this one towards the leg side but gets a leading edge towards point. He wants a single but is sent back by his skipper.
Length ball on middle again, this time Ahmed rocks back and pulls this one in front of square for a couple.
Length ball on middle and off, pushed back towards the bowler.
Length ball this time, Azam pulls this one towards deep mid-wicket and rotates strike.
On the pads of Ahmed, he uppishly flicks this one towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Cummins is back on. He was excellent in his first spell. 6 runs and a wicket off his first 2 overs.
On the pads of Iftikhar, he flicks this one towards mid-wicket and will keep strike for the next over.
Ahmed pushes this one back towards the bowler.
On the pads, flicked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on middle and leg, Ahmed pushes this one towards mid on and takes a single.
Iftikhar Ahmed is the new man in. His skipper is fighting a lone battle from the other end. Can he be the one to support him and provide this innings the much needed impetus it needs?

OUT! CAUGHT! The single has cost them as Ali has to depart now. Floated ball on middle and leg, Ali plays the slog sweep after getting his front foot out of the way. The ball goes high towards wide long on but does not have enough power on it to go all the way. Cummins in the deep takes an easy catch. Pakistan losing wickets in a heap here and not gathering any momentum.
Floated on middle and leg, Azam hits it down the ground towards long on. Azam sets off for a couple but Asif Ali does not want the second. Azam is agitated as he thought there was a second on offer.
Tossed up on middle again, Asif strokes it wide of long on. Babar calls for two straightaway and they get it.
Floated on middle and leg, Babar comes down the track and nudges it to long on and rotates the strike.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Asif whips it behind square on the leg side for a run.
Flighted on middle, Babar milks it to long on for another single.
Quicker on middle. Bowled at 98.0 kph. Asif glances it to the on side for a single.
Floated on middle and leg, Babar flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Cummins was about to bowl but Finch has then decided to give it back to Zampa.
Floated on off, pushed to the off side by Ali.
Asif Ali walks out to bat now.

OUT! STUMPED! Rizwan's struggles have come to an end. Agar floats one ball on middle and leg. Rizwan comes down the track to attack the ball but misses it completely. The ball sneaks through his bat and pad. Carey collects it and whips the bails off with Rizwan way out of his crease. Pakistan struggling to get going as they are now 62/3.
On the pads of Azam, he flicks this one towards the leg side and takes one.
Azam looks to flick this one but is hit on the pads.
FOUR! Flicked away! On the pads, Azam flicks this one in front of square and the ball races to the fence. McDermott in the deep dives to save the boundary but fails to do so.

A slight hesitation between the batters but they survive. Rizwan comes down the track and pushes this one towards cover. He wants the single but there is slight hesitation between the two and Rizwan puts in a dive at the end which saves him.
Rizwan comes down the track but does not time it. He manages to just milk it down to long off off the lower half of his bat for a single. Good over for Pakistan. They needed it. 13 from it.
Floated on off, Azam looks to push it towards the off side but the ball goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket and the batters take one.
Floated on middle and leg, Azam pushes this one down to long on and takes a couple.
FOUR! SMASHED! Babar Azam steps down the track and smashes this one back past the bowler for a boundary. Azam oozing in confidence.
Follows it up with a single by gently dabbing it to short third man.

FOUR! Nicely played! Rizwan premiditates what he wanted to do. He moves away as Zampa comes in. Zampa sees it and bowls it a bit wide. Mohammad though drags his sweep and hits it wide of long on for a boundary. Much needed one for him.
On leg, Rizwan tries to flick this one but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards third man and the batters take a leg bye.
Azam flicks this one off the back foot towards square leg for a single.
Beautiful shot from Rizwan. He dances down the track and lofts it inside out over covers but gets just a single.
Azam flicks this one fine down the leg side for one.
On the pads of Rizwan, he flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.

Beautiful work from Ashton Agar! He floats one on middle and off. Rizwan comes down the track and tries to push it towards mid off but Agar dives to his left and gathers the ball. He quickly gets up and has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Carey collects the ball and dislodges the bails as Rizwan puts in the dive. The umpire refers it upstairs but Rizwan's dive has saved him.
Spin from both ends. The left arm spin of Ashton Agar into the action now.
Shortish outside off, Azam cuts this one but straight to the man at point. 6 off the over and Australia on top.
On the pads of Rizwan, he flicks this one wide of mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on off, Azam pushes this one towards mid off and rotates the strike.
Rizwan comes down the track and pushes it towards cover for one.
Again shortish on middle and off, Rizwan pulls this one towards long on and takes a couple.
Shortish and wide outside off, Azam cuts it towards point and takes one.
Spin time! Adam Zampa into the attack.

Length ball on off, Azam defends it with soft hands off his back foot to the off side and gets a single. Another good over from Cummins. Just 3 from this one as well. Only 6 runs off Cummin's two so far. Pakistan after a flashy start have tailed off and are 32/2 at the end of Powerplay.

Quick single. Nervy way to get off the mark. Good length ball on middle, Rizwan pushes it to the right of mid on and calls for a quick single. Warner quickly gets to the ball but fails to gather it cleanly. That helps Rizwan's case and he gets to the other end with relative ease.

Cummins bowling with some venom here. Good length ball on middle and leg, Rizwan looks to defend but gets an inside edge. The ball goes towards point after deflecting of his boot. He looks for a quick single but his skipper says no.
Good length ball on middle, it zips in off the deck. Rizwan does well to defend it.
Good length ball on off, Rizwan starts off with a back foot defense.
Good length ball on off, Azam pushes it wide of mid on for a single.
Mohammad Rizwan comes out to bat now with Pakistan in a spot of bother.

OUT! Caught and Bowled! Richardson makes a strong comeback after going for 11 in his first over. Richardson hits the deck hard on middle and off, Haris clears his front leg and looks to play a big pull over mid-wicket. He is a bit early in his short as the ball takes the top edge and goes high in the air. It comes down where silly point would have been placed. Richardson calls for the catch and takes it with ease. Two down Pakistan and their good start has not lasted long here.

In the air but in no man's land. Full on off and middle, Haris comes down and looks to go over covers. He does not time it well but there is no man in the deep there so he gets a couple as the man from sweeper cover cleans it up.
Slower ball on top of middle and leg, Haris guides it towards backward point and looks for a single but does not get it and rightfully so as all it would have been was a suicidal run out.
Length ball on top of middle, Haris pushes it to cover.
Good length ball on off, Babar nudges it to the right of point and eases to the other end.
On the pads, Haris whips it towards square leg and gets a single.
Change of ends for Kane Richardson.
Length ball on top of off, Haris punches it to the right of mid off and keeps the strike. Brilliant start for Cummins. 3 runs and a wicket off his first.
Haris is off the mark. On the pads, Sohail flicks it through mid-wicket and gets a couple to get his scorecard ticking.
Bouncer! Cummins peppers Haris with a short one. Sohail keeps his eyes on the ball and ducks under it.
Fuller on off, Haris starts his innings with a watchful defense.
Haris Sohail is the next man in.

OUT! Caught! Cummins strikes in his very second ball of the first over! Fakhar Zaman's poor run in T20Is continues. Full on off, Fakhar looks to hit a short-arm jab over mid off. The ball rises a bit higher than he anticipated and it comes off the upper half of his bat. He does not get the elevation and the ball goes to the left of mid off. David Warner there slides to that side and takes a good low catch.
Cummins starts with a full ball on middle and leg, Fakhar taps it back to the bowler.
Pat Cummins replaces Kane Richardson after just one over bowled by the latter.

Babar is angry at himself. Length ball around off, Babar smashes it hard but to the right of point. Steve Smith there manages to stop it. Babar grunt out a loud shout as he knew he should have scored a boundary there.
Good ball. Starc steams in a very full and pacy ball on off at over 147 kph. Babar manages to squeeze it to backward point.
FOUR! Geez this is beautiful batting. Around the hips of Babar, he shows his class and picks it with ease over mid-wicket for a boundary.
On off, Azam punches it to cover-point.
Another beautiful shot but this one is straight to cover. Good length ball on off, Babar punches this hard too but this time to the man at cover.
FOUR! Off like a bullet train! Length ball outside off, Babar gets on his back foot and smashes his punch through covers. And in a blink of an eye the ball is off to the fence.
Dot to finish the over but an expensive start for Richardson. 11 off his first. Length ball on off, Babar hits it off the back foot with no foot movement straight to cover. Solid start for Pakistan.
Another one on the pads, Babar glances it to the on side and gets to the other end.
Around the pads, Babar flicks it with ease through mid-wicket for a couple.
Comes closer to the off pole, Babar defends it with a horizontal bat off his back foot.

FOUR! This time off the back foot! Another beautiful shot. Back of a length around off, Babar gets on his back foot and punches it through covers for another boundary. Not an ideal start for Kane here.
FOUR! Classic Babar cover drive. Beautiful shot this. Good length ball on off, Babar gets on his front foot and drives it on the up through covers for a boundary.
Kane Richardson to bowl from the other end.
Full and fast down the leg side, Fakhar looks to flick but the ball clips his boot and goes behind to Carey. 3 off the first over. Nice start for Australia.
Full ball outside off, Zaman drives it past the diving point fielder for a single.
This time flicks it but straight to mid-wicket.

Direct hit and Babar would have been back to the hut. Full inswinging ball on middle and leg, Fakhar looks to flick. All he gets is a thin inside edge onto the pads. He comes out looking for a run but then decides against it. Babar was half way out and had to go back. The fielder at mid-wicket gets to the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end. Babar puts in a desperate dive but if it was a direct hit, this would have been it.
In the air but in the gap. Starc corrects his line and bowls a full ball outside off, Babar drives it uppishly through backward point for a single.
Starc starts with a terrible ball first up. It is a full toss on middle and off, Babar does not expect it and he ends up just pushing it towards mid on. Real let off for Starc first up.

We are all set to begin! The Australian players walk out onto the field with their skipper leading them. Pakistan skipper, Babar Azam walks out with Fakhar Zaman to open the innings. The left-arm pace of Mitchell Starc to start the proceedings with the ball. The Pakistan skipper will face the first ball. Here we go!
Pakistan (Unchanged Playing XI): Fakhar Zaman, Babar Azam (C), Haris Sohail, Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Asif Ali, Iftikhar Ahmed, Imad Wasim, Wahab Riaz, Shadab Khan, Mohammad Amir, Mohammad Irfan.
Australia (Unchanged Playing XI): David Warner, Aaron Finch (C), Steven Smith, Ben McDermott, Ashton Turner, Alex Carey (WK), Ashton Agar, Pat Cummins, Mitchell Starc, Kane Richardson, Adam Zampa.
TOSS - We are all set for the spin of the coin. Australian skipper, Aaron Finch has the coin in hand. Up it goes and it comes down in  favour of Babar Azam. PAKISTAN OPT TO BAT!

So, after the first T20I was abandoned due to rain, it's now time for the 2nd T20I between Australia and Pakistan which is going to be played at Canberra. It is the first ever T20I which is going to be played at the Manuka Oval. So far, Australia have been decimating opponents at home. First, it was Sri Lanka, who were thrashed 3-0 in the T20I series. Australia were way better than them in all departments and the same story continued in the first T20I between Pakistan and the hosts as they were cruising to a win before rain saved the visitors' blushes. The showers came pouring down with 78 runs needed in 71 balls for Australia and it would have been a pretty easy task for them. Pakistan will be hoping to improve on that performance and gain an advantage in what is now a 2-match T20I series. Will the no.1 T20I side in the world come up with a surprise performance? Or will the hosts roll them over? Stay tuned for the Toss.
